sdkHead.$comment: Branch head of the SDK repo at last verification (merge of the 'Update 1.0' PR line). scripts/check-currency.mjs compares the live head against this; the newest version's sdkCommit stays the commit that last regenerated Source/Pal/Public.

upstream.$comment: Third-party projects whose versions this registry's compatibility claims name. check-currency compares each against its live release list; bump these with the README line that cites them.
